lessons: All three review findings are plan defects, and their paved road is 'fix the plan, then re-author the ticket'. Another implementer retry cannot clear them. Section 20 must change first.

Section 20 gives checkpoint-push only squatch/checkpoint.py, tests/test_checkpoint.py and the squatch/daemon.py hook. squatch/git.py has no push operation, so the seed must leave its fence or bypass git.py. The plan must add git.py and its test to the fence.

The plan never says how a trip's emitting_stage maps to a drain offer. The drain selects whole tickets, so an implement trip pauses everything and a check/review trip suppresses nothing. The plan must define stage-selectable dispatch first.
phase3-continue-18 demands exact Context pins for checkpoint-push and phase3-continue-19 but never names that Context. The plan must list it, e.g. squatch/daemon.py plus one established seeded test.
Once the plan is fixed, regenerate by rerunning the owning deliverable. Don't hand-patch the untracked ticket files or tests/test_seeded_phase3_17.py.
reason: The review gate showed that section 20 is under-specified for both seeds (a checkpoint fence without git push, no stage-to-offer mapping for the hold, no named successor Context), so the ticket can't be satisfied until the plan is fixed.
